歌词翻译 :pkericya(苍雪)

Fear not this night. You will not go astray. Though shadows fall still thestars..find their way. 英雄们啊！在此夜不必惧怕，你的路途不会走错。尽管黑夜降临，星辰仍高挂夜空。 你们总会找到出路。
Awakenfrom a quiet sleep. Hear the whispering of the wind. 英雄们将在沉睡之中觉醒，聆听风的低语。
Awaken asthe silence grows in the solitude of the night 你将在孤寂的夜中觉醒。
Darknessspreads through all the land and your weary eyes open silently. 黑暗权势在土地上扩展，疲倦的眼静静地睁开。
Sunsetshave forsaken all and must open their eyes now 连日落都遗弃了大地，你必须睁大眼睛。
Nightmarescome when shadows grow.... Ice glows and heartbeats slow 梦魇来自黑影的环绕… 寒霜发光，心跳也缓慢了。
